title: Reject Inconsistent Loop Closures
summary: `gate_loop_closures(residuals, covariance, overlap, elapsed, threshold, min_overlap, min_elapsed)` residuals(K,6),0<=K<=8192, translationmeters+rotationradians supplied same tangent convention; covariance(K,6,6),symmetricatol1e-9 thenaverage,positive eigenvalues satisfy lambda_min>=max(1e-9,lambda_max*1e-8). overlap(K)fraction[0,1],elapsed(K)seconds[0,1e6];thresholdscalar[0,1e6]on squaredMahalanobis,min_overlap[0,1],min_elapsed[0,1e6]. Return squared_distance(K)=r.Tsolve(C,r),accepted(K)=(d<=threshold)&(overlap>=min)&(elapsed>=min),reason int64(K) priority1 elapsed too short,2 overlap low,3 Mahalanobis too large,0 accepted. All values validated even rejected for earlierreasons. Covariance cross terms matter. Original operational consistency gate for supplied registration evidence; not LIO-SAM's actual ICP fitness heuristic, a probability guarantee, or loop proposal/registration. Example r=[2,0,0,0,0,0],C=I,threshold4,overlap.5,min.5,elapsed10,min10=>d4accepted. Exampleelapsed9 andoverlap0 andlargeerror=>reason1; empty arrayscorrectshapes.
